subject: Problems running Distance 3.5 analyses on Windows NT 4.00

messages.author: afd254666c82a758
messages.subject: Problems running Distance 3.5 analyses on Windows NT 4.00
parts:
My agency is currently replacing PC's with NT machines that run Windows NT
4.00, and those of us who use Distance 3.5 Release 5 are all encountering
problems running analyses on the new system.

Our administrator has not encountered any problems with installing Distance
3.5 and the program starts up as expected. However, upon running any
analysis, the following error message is logged:

** Error: An error occured within the analysis engine. This could be due to
a problem in the Distance analysis engine, or could be becuase the analysis
was reset just as it was finishing. **

Our IT support is unable to provide a solution to this problem.
Unfortunately, this does not appear to be a problem with NT users outside of
this agency (those I have asked and nothing in the archives), so few clues
there.

This is a specific problem so please send replies directly to me at the
address below. Any advise/suggestions would be welcomed.

Chris

This was corrected by providing degrees as the unit in 4.0.

messages.subject: Re: Problems running Distance 3.5 analyses on Windows NT 4.00
parts:
> >I have also had a problem with Distance 3.5 on my laptop, with Windows
> >2000 Professional. Upon installing, I am told I need the latest NT
> >service pack. I did not install the latest NT service pack, and am given
> >the same error message as earlier reported:
> >
>> >> ** Error: An error occured within the analysis engine. This could be due
> >to
>> >> a problem in the Distance analysis engine, or could be becuase the
> >analysis
>> >> was reset just as it was finishing. **
>> >>
> >

The current release of Distance 3.5 has a bug in the install program, which
means it doesn't install in Win2k. This is documented on the Distance web
site, support page, under Known Problems in Distance 3.5. I have a test
version of an installation which should work on Windows 2000 -- if anyone
needs it please email me. I know of one problem with the test version -- if
you have office 2000 installed, it asks for the office CD the first time you
run Distance. I hope to get to the bottom of this soon, at which point I'll
make a public release of the package (this will be Distance 3.5 Release 6).

> >I also had a problem with DISTANCE 4.0, in which I was given an error
> >message suggesting I contact the program authors. I was importing a
> >Distance 3.5 data file into 4.0. The angle data imported without units.
> >This was corrected by providing degrees as the unit in 4.0.

This is caused by bad documentation in the D4 manual, and poor defaults and
error messages in the program (see D4 known problem #117, on the distance web
pages). I'll fix these in the full D4 release.

Please report any other problems you find in D4 on the
distance-sampling-d4beta list (see the D4 manual for more about this list).

Cheers,

- Len Thomas
